newsitem.title: UK: Freight rates decline again, BFI at new 4-yr low.
newsitem.headline: Freight rates decline again, BFI at new 4-yr low.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) posted a seven-point loss taking it to a fresh four-year low of 1,056 on Monday.
The previous four-year low was 1,060 hit on August 8.
Brokers said that the absence of grain cargoes for October shipment and a scarcity of the same for September as the reason for the BFI's fall.
Grain fixtures concluded on Monday showed that rates on the main grain route were continuing to decline.
Korea Line fixed the Polska Walczaca to carry 54,000 tonnes of hss from the U.S. Gulf to Japan at $19.20 basis no combination ports, versus $19.25 seen on Friday.
A slightly smaller cargo of 52,000 tonnes was fixed by Belships on the same route on the M Farouk at $19.
Biffex futures dropped in line with the sentiment sent by the dry cargo sector, with most active Oct down 12 at 1,780 by 1530 gmt amid a volume of 225 lots.
Total traded volume on the Biffex futures amounted to 444 lots at 1530 GMT.
